pages.text: To prevent emissions from spreading around the $(l:ecology_inst/page01)furnace$(), place a chimney nearby. If your furnace generates too many emissions, place more chimneys.$(br)If a chimney is blocked by a block (except a $(l:ecology_inst/page02)filter$()), it will eventually explode.
"I would add a block, but I'll leave it to you)"
